_doc: Human-written entries merged LAST by gen_vocab_defs.py. null = drop the word (not a vocabulary item).

colourless.def: having no colour at all, like clear water
colourless.ex: Clean water is colourless, so you can see through it.

fierce.def: very angry and strong, ready to attack
fierce.ex: The fierce dog barked loudly at the stranger by the gate.

fiercely.def: in a very angry and strong way
fiercely.ex: The two cats fought fiercely over the last piece of fish.

performers.def: people who sing, dance or act for an audience
performers.ex: The performers bowed when the audience clapped at the end.

wicked.def: very bad and cruel to others
wicked.ex: The wicked witch in the story locked the children in a tower.
